capabilities: Indexes typed frontmatter notes as ontology entities
Runs local OWL 2 EL reasoning and draws the hierarchy
Answers SPARQL queries in a panel or in-note block
Applies reviewed frontmatter edits as diffs
Extracts facts through a user-configured model endpoint
extras: Desktop only, minimum Obsidian 1.7.2; offline by default with a network-disabled release test and SHA-256-pinned engine. Documents plain-http and redirect-transport caveats; Jev helpers are unevaluated research candidates; corpus timings are historical.
problem: Backlinks show that two notes are related but not how, and Obsidian has no built-in way to type notes, infer class hierarchies, or query them with SPARQL.

relations.evidence: The in-note surface and its two tokens follow Cristian Vasquez's Dot Triples
Dot Triples does that, and Ontomark's bridge joins the two graphs.

requires.name: model endpoint (HTTPS URL) for assisted fact extraction
session API key for the model endpoint

summary: Local ontology layer that indexes typed notes, runs OWL 2 EL reasoning and SPARQL, draws the hierarchy, and applies reviewed frontmatter edits.
